deskSendNothingLeaves: Nothing leaves until you press Send. After that it cannot be taken back.

@deskSendNothingLeaves.description: Line under the Send button on Send at the Shallow level, and under the title of the password dialog that follows.

@deskSendLiveTo.description: Heading of Send after a payment went out, at every level. {name} is the contact's name.

@deskSendLiveAmountTo.description: Line under the heading of Send after a payment went out. {amount} is the amount, {name} the contact's name.

@deskSendLiveAmount.description: Line under the heading of Send after a payment went out, when the recipient has no name. {amount} is the amount.

@deskSendLiveVia.description: Send result title (Deep end) when the payment has no contact name; via is how it travels, e.g. 'via file'.

@deskSendLiveAmountVia.description: Send result line when the payment has no contact name; via is how it travels, e.g. 'via file'.

@deskSendDoneTo.description: Heading of Send after a payment went out, once it is confirmed. {name} is the contact's name.

@deskSendDoneVia.description: Heading of Send after a payment went out, once it is confirmed, when the payment has no contact name; via is how it travelled, e.g. 'via file'.
